rock: Production game sprite sheet for a top-down 2D pixel art RPG. Transparent alpha background, no labels, no text, no scenery, no ground shadow. EXACT grid: 8 columns by 5 rows, 40 sprites, equal cells, generous transparent gutters, every foot baseline at 85% cell height. Row directions: row1 facing south/front, row2 southeast three-quarter front facing right, row3 east/right profile, row4 northeast three-quarter back facing right, row5 north/back. Columns: 1 relaxed idle; 2 breathing idle; 3 left-foot step; 4 passing stride; 5 right-foot step; 6 opposite passing stride; 7 full melee attack with arm extended forward; 8 recoiling hurt. Maintain IDENTICAL character proportions and physical design across all cells. Compact chibi monster approximately 1.5 times human width, head integrated with heavy torso, readable short legs and big arms. Consistent crisp pixel-art blocks and dark outline, limited palette with 3 shade steps, no smooth gradients or blur. All poses fully inside cells including attack hands, empty margin on every side, NOT a concept collage. Orthographic slightly overhead view, not isometric. Character: living crag rock golem made entirely of angular layered sandstone and gray-brown basalt boulders. Wide rocky shoulders, large uneven boulder fists, squat sturdy rock feet, recessed warm amber glowing eyes, small fissure glow in chest, no human bones, no skull, no clothes or weapons. Brown cliff palette, small moss flecks. Threatening but charming chunky RPG silhouette.
